summary: Best 98.444 (r6b4_lrg at 18.05B, CP7; incumbent 98.349): the first greedy episode through the -y basement hole into the room above the finish funnel. 0 finishes. Root cause of the last gate (WR demo, measurement only; it replays exactly in our sim): in the basement U-turn the policy strafes 1.5 deg off the velocity (human 0), so the turn adds nothing, it wall-rides and loses ~300 u/s, and its kick cannot clear the funnel rim. What worked: an LR anneal (3e-4 -> 5e-5) ended the chimney-mode wobble (23+ CP7 evals in a row), and 5% spawns on own-root Go-Explore paths (held strafe macros in the simulator, no demo) gave the room entry. Did not work: NEW --respawn-greedy-speed[-band] (broke the line), NEW --front-heads/--front-ou/--front-record (held the line, U-turn unchanged), 15% path spawns at lr 3e-4. Next: a Go-Explore line that FINISHES (~15% more kick energy) as the spawn source.
